# Librerías 
```{r}
pacman::p_load(dplyr, purrr, here, lme4)
```

#Configuración 

```{r}
cohortes <- c("CIVED_1999", "ICCS_2009", "ICCS_2016", "PACES_2019")

etiq <- c(CIVED_1999 = "CIVED 1999", ICCS_2009 = "ICCS 2009",
          ICCS_2016  = "ICCS 2016",  PACES_2019 = "PACES 2019")

dir_out <- here("output", "modelos_escrito")
dir.create(dir_out, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

#Cargar los modelos

```{r}
MODELOS <- lapply(setNames(cohortes, cohortes), function(co)
  readRDS(here("output", "modelos_rds", paste0("modelos_", co, ".rds"))))
```

# ICC

```{r}
datos_icc <- map_dfr(cohortes, function(co) {
  m0    <- MODELOS[[co]]$M0
  tau00 <- as.numeric(VarCorr(m0)$id_colegio)
  tibble(
    cohorte = co,
    tau00   = tau00,
    icc     = tau00 / (tau00 + pi^2 / 3),
    n_est   = nobs(m0),
    n_esc   = ngrps(m0)[["id_colegio"]]
  )
})

datos_icc
```

```{r}
for (co in cohortes) {
  d <- readRDS(here("output", "data_procesada", paste0("proc_", co, ".rds")))
  cat("\n", co, "\n")
  print(table(d$voto, useNA = "ifany"))
}
```

```{r}
# (a) Escala original de CIVED y de ICCS: ¿qué significa el 1 y el 4?
CIVED_1999 <- haven::read_sav(here("input", "data", "cs_chlf2.sav"))
ICCS_2009  <- haven::read_sav(here("input", "data", "ISGCHLC2.sav"))
attr(CIVED_1999$CS5M1, "labels")
attr(ICCS_2009$IS2P32B, "labels")

# (b) ¿Qué tienen las bases guardadas hoy?
d <- readRDS(here("output", "data_procesada", "proc_CIVED_1999.rds"))
grep("_cwc$|_est$", names(d), value = TRUE)
table(d$nivel_educ, useNA = "ifany")
```
